meta.prompt_source: 用户提供题面：英语二大作文（图表：某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比）

band.rationale: 作文包含所有内容要点：三组数据齐全，并有原因分析与建议，符合第四档'较好地完成了试题规定的任务''包含所有内容要点'的描述；采用 Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 等衔接手法，'层次清晰，组织较严密'。但语言未达到该档'语言基本准确'的要求——percentage 误用、主谓一致、助动词后动词形式等基础错误几乎每段出现，故取第四档下限 10 分。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三组数据全部覆盖且解读无误，切题；但只逐项罗列数字，未先概括总体特征（如超八成学生参与不足），图表解读停留在表层。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 两个原因加一条建议，要点齐全但每个原因只各写一个分句，未做任何展开或举例；另有字数 135 词、低于建议的 150 词（达下限 90%，按规则属小幅不足，不机械罚分，仅提示）。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: There are many reasons for this phenomonon. Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work... In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
dimensions.deduction_reason: '描述—原因—评论'三段式与题面要求一一对应，Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 衔接清楚；但第二段第二个原因内部两个独立分句仅用逗号硬接（comma splice），句间衔接手段单一。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 10 句中出现约 5 处语法错误：does not provides（助动词后未用原形）、activities is（主谓一致）、It 指代复数、the the 相邻重复、逗号粘连；好在均不阻碍理解，且 while 从句与 Only in this way 倒装使用正确，故给 1 分而非更低。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more. ... There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
dimensions.deduction_reason: '数字+percentage' 的误用全篇重复三次，属系统性搭配错误；另有 phenomonon 拼写错误及 learn skill / make friend 单复数误用；词汇量能满足任务但偏基础。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: 'shows the situation of students taking part in' 表达偏绕，可直接点明图表内容（参与频率），行文更直接
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: 'percentage' 是名词，不能直接跟在数字后，正确结构是'数字 + percent of + 名词'，此误用全篇出现三次；'take part in one to two times' 中 in 后缺宾语，频次应作状语而非宾语
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them take part once or twice every month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: '20 percentage students' 结构不成立，应为 '20 percent of the students'；'join' 后接活动需有宾语，或改用 'join in / take part in'
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students join in three times or more.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写有误，应为 phenomenon
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: 助动词 does not 后须用动词原形 provide；两个独立分句仅用逗号连接（comma splice），应加 so 或改用句号；'how to join' 后缺宾语，宜为 how to join in
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to join in.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主语 activities 为复数，谓语应用 are
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: 指代复数的 activities 应用 They；learn skill 与 make friend 均应为复数 skills、friends
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: 'the the' 相邻重复；'balance the study' 中 study 前不应加定冠词，应为 balance study and volunteer work
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more chances, and students should balance study and volunteer work.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities every month. 35 percent of the students never join in such activities, while 45 percent of them take part once or twice a month. Only 20 percent join in three times or more.

There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students think that studying is more important than volunteer work, so they spend most of their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students do not know how to join in.

In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students. They can help us learn skills and make friends. Therefore, the school should offer more chances, and students should balance study and volunteer work. Only in this way can we grow up better.
top_problems: '数字 + percentage' 的用法反复出错（全篇 3 次），应统一改为 'X percent of the students'，这是词汇维度失分的主因
主谓一致与助动词后动词形式不稳（activities is / does not provides / It can help us），几乎每段都有，是语法维度的主要扣分点
独立分句用逗号硬接（comma splice，如第二段 Second 句），应改用 so / and 连接或拆成两句
practice_advice: 下次限时写作完成后做'三查'自检：数字后是否用 percent of、主语与动词单复数是否一致、助动词后是否为动词原形，每查出一处即改正并朗读改后句子三遍，坚持两周可消除本篇一半以上的失分点。

patterns: There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
In my opinion, ... are good for students. They can help us ...
Only in this way can we ...
words: once or twice a month / three times or more
